personality_one_liner: A highly legible, map-first transit experience that uses crisp typography and a vibrant green/blue palette to instill confidence and clarity for commuters in Nova Lima.

spacing.rule: Generous map exposure with tight, structured padding within data cards to fit transit metrics.

do's: Use glassmorphism for the floating search bar / filter pills layered over the live map.
Use glassmorphism for the bottom tab bar to let the map bleed through.
Use glassmorphism for map overlay controls like 're-center' FAB.
dont's: Do not use glassmorphism on the data-heavy route cards or arrival schedules (needs max legibility).

screens.name: Home / Live Map
screens.purpose: A map-first dashboard showing nearby stops and a bottom sheet with favorite lines and quick actions.

states.loading: Map loading state with skeleton bottom sheet.
states.empty: No nearby stops found - prompt user to search a specific route.
states.error: Location access denied message with a settings CTA.

screens.layout: Full-bleed react-native-maps view behind a glass floating search bar. A Gorhom bottom sheet rests in the bottom third containing 'Nearby Stops' and 'Favorite Lines' cards. Map has custom markers for stops.

screens.name: Bus Routes List
screens.purpose: A structured directory of all available bus lines in Nova Lima.

states.error: Failed to load routes, retry button.

screens.layout: Standard iOS-Native list view. Large title header, sticky search input. Route items show Bus Number (in a brandPrimary pill) alongside Route Name and next arrival time.

screens.name: Route Detail & Schedule
screens.purpose: Provides the specific schedule, full trajectory map, and real-time (mocked) status for a single line.

states.empty: No active buses on this line currently.

screens.layout: Split layout: Top 40% is the trajectory map. Bottom 60% is a scrollable vertical timeline (using a subtle left border with dots) displaying stops. Current bus location is indicated by a brandSecondary (green) glowing dot.

screens.name: Route Planner
screens.purpose: Origin to Destination trip planner yielding the best bus transit options.

states.empty: No valid route found between selected points.

screens.layout: Top section: Stacked text inputs for 'From' and 'To' with a swap button. Bottom section: Result cards showing total time, walk duration, and bus line pill. Each card has max 5-6 key metrics.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage account, guest mode, saved places, and service rating.
screens.layout: Standard iOS inset-grouped list. Top section shows user avatar/email (or Guest login CTA), followed by rows for Saved Locations, Alerts, and Rate Service.

onboarding_hero.alt: A modern blue bus driving down a city street, representing NL BUS

nova_lima_cityscape.alt: Aerial view of a coastal city, representing the region of Nova Lima

map_navigation_empty.alt: Hand holding a smartphone displaying a map, used for empty map states

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the requested 'Verde e azul' palette: use the brandPrimary (#0284C7 Blue) for structural elements, headers, and route lines. Use brandSecondary (#10B981 Green) exclusively for active, live, or 'success' elements (e.g., real-time arrival text, 'bus is here' markers, 'Go' buttons).
Implement the Home Screen using a map-first 'Map-as-UI' approach. The map must be full-bleed using react-native-maps. Overlay a @gorhom/bottom-sheet containing nearby stops and favorite lines.
Do not anchor heavy text menus on top of the map. Use floating glassmorphic pills for the search bar and filter toggles on the map view.
For the Route Detail screen, use a vertical timeline layout (a left-aligned line with nodes) to represent the bus stops sequentially.
Data density: On route cards, group information logically and strictly limit to 5-6 metrics (bus number, destination, arrival time, total duration, crowd status). Do not clutter the card.
Ensure safe area is respected on the full-screen map, keeping floating action buttons above the bottom navigation bar and below the status bar.
Since Real-time tracking is 'em breve' (coming soon), mock the bus locations on the map using a distinct custom marker (perhaps a glowing green dot) and label it clearly in the UI.
Apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 1 vertical gradient to Layer 0 image) if placing text over the onboarding_hero or nova_lima_cityscape images.
